public_holidays: 2027-09-08 (Wednesday): Nossa Senhora da Natividade, patron of the state, state holiday (Lei 627/1993)
2027-10-05 (Tuesday): Criação do Estado do Tocantins, state holiday (Lei 98/1989); in 2026 the state moved it to 9 October by decree, so the 2027 observance may move too
culture-cycles.note: The state sets other optional days (pontos facultativos, such as Carnival) by a yearly decree for its own offices; the 2027 decree is not yet published. Municipal holidays are not covered here.

laws.rule: Tocantins state Lei 4.133/2023 bans letting off loud-bang fireworks and any noisy pyrotechnic device across the state, indoors or outdoors, on public or private land. Sight-only fireworks are excepted. Fine: R$1,500 for a person and R$4,000 for a company (about A$393 and A$1,049 (A$1 = R$3.8138, Banco Central do Brasil PTAX, 30 Oct 2026)), updated yearly by the IPCA inflation index and doubled for a repeat within 30 days.
